name: waveform
title: Waveform
description: A recording as a row of bars, in ink as far as it has played.
use: A voice message or a short clip: the shape of the sound, drawn as thin bars that fill with ink as the recording plays. The page's player sets --waveform-progress on the row as the audio plays, and an optional range input over the bars seeks. The bars are decorative; the seek input or the time beside them carries the meaning.

instead.when: It is how far a task has come, not a recording
It is a value to set, with no sound behind it
The bars are numbers a reader compares

keyboard.action: With waveform-seek: step back or forward through the recording, as any range input does
With waveform-seek: go to the start or the end
With waveform-seek: take a larger step

platform.fallback: Each bar takes its exact height, and the round of a bar's ends may be cut flat by part of a pixel

classes.name: waveform
classes.description: The row, 32px tall, centered on its middle line. It fills its container, or in a row of other things takes the width its bars need. Its ink is currentColor

classes.name: waveform-sm
classes.description: A 20px row of 2px bars, 1.5px apart, for a line of a list

classes.name: waveform-lg
classes.description: A 48px row of 4px bars, 3px apart, for a player

classes.name: waveform-bar
classes.description: One bar, an empty element as tall as its --level of the row and never shorter than it is wide. Ink up to the playhead, a quiet tint after it

classes.name: waveform-seek
classes.description: A native range input laid invisibly over the bars, last in the row: the pointer and the keys seek with it, and the row draws its focus ring. Give it an aria-label and an aria-valuetext in words

classes.name: waveform-time
classes.description: The length of the recording, or how much has played, beside the row: small tabular figures in the ink of the place it stands in

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: The row takes the focus ring, drawn in its own ink so it shows on a sent bubble too

states.name: hover
states.description: With a pointer that hovers, the bars still to play step up a little, to say they can be touched

states.name: disabled
states.description: The row keeps its drawing and no longer answers the pointer

properties.name: --waveform-progress
properties.description: How far the recording has played, from 0 to 1. The page's player sets it

properties.name: --level
properties.description: How loud the recording is at this bar, from 0 to 1: the bar's share of the row's height

properties.name: --waveform-height
properties.description: Height of the row, and of the loudest bar

properties.name: --waveform-bar
properties.description: Width of a bar, and the height of the shortest

properties.name: --waveform-color
properties.description: The ink of what has played; what has not is a tint of it

example: 0:14
